ec6606822833912094053991858dc8d3444ed9cf.summary: IBM X-Force IRIS reports attacks likely linked to Hive0065 (also known as TA505), a financially motivated cybercrime group active since at least 2014. The attacks used spear-phishing emails impersonating Onehub to deliver the SDBbot RAT, mainly as a second-stage payload, plus CobaltStrike-like DLLs and Meterpreter reverse shells. After gaining access, the actor escalated privileges, moved laterally and compromised a domain admin account. Attribution is hedged as likely, not confirmed.

ec7d70f1abbdff4227a39b98306a490085cb5bf6.summary: F5 Labs reports a new Perl-based IRC botnet, Tuyul, that exploits unpatched PHPUnit systems (CVE-2017-9841) and also uses PHP web shells. Its peak size was about 366 victim systems, most hosted on cloud services, with U.S. and U.K. servers making up almost half. F5 judged the operator probably located in Indonesia, based on a time zone setting, admin nicknames, Indonesian phrases and the botnet name. It did not attribute the botnet to a state actor and could not say whether it is linked to organised crime. Only maintenance activity was seen, with no mass activation.
